title: docs(qa): checklist items for action preflight and page bindings, AI data tools and MCP, federation and the CLI since 18.3.0
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNtnAWVAx9Kw9aAH5yGHwqF)_

Fixes #32269

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 18.4.0 发布测试台账补上 18.3.0 之后落地的三块能力的测试项：动作参数对话框的预检读取（preflight）与页面 API 绑定（row-table 表格块、动作成功后自动重读）；AI 数据工具与 MCP（数据集工具、指标同义词、read_file 读 PDF/Word、工具调用拦截器、列表链接筛选整体拒绝）；Oracle / SQL Server 联邦与 CLI（仅联邦驱动、`os deploy --dry-run/--json`、`os validate --target`、升级计划的覆盖提示）。共新增 19 条，并把 `ai.mcp-http-surface` 的工具计数改为 17/12。
- 为什么改：发布前的 `since:v18.4` 测试轮只能测台账里有的东西；这三块能力此前没有任何条目，测试员会漏测。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` 下的台账文件，没有产品代码、权限或数据语义变化，可直接 revert。
- 先看：`FOLLOW-UPS.md` 的 §18（范围、哪些条目被阻塞或计划中及原因），然后是 `areas/records-forms.json` 末尾的 preflight 面板条目。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`（exit 0）；`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4` 应列出 48 条可跑条目，其中 14 条来自本 PR；另有 4 条因缺少 Oracle、SQL Server 测试库或 AI 服务而标为 blocked，加 `--include-blocked` 后为 58 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## Premise

The card's premise commands at the base (`9091955b`, history deepened past the 18.3.0 subject with `git fetch --shallow-since=2026-11-02T00:00:00Z origin main`):

```
$ git log --oneline 83d7e4ae..origin/main | grep -ciE 'preflight|row-table|list_datasets|query_dataset|read_file|interceptor|oracle|sql ?server|mssql|deploy --dry-run|validate --target'
29
$ node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4
selector: since:v18.4 → 34 runnable item(s) (6 blocked, hidden — pass --include-blocked)
```

Before this PR every `since: "v18.4"` item was M1's (themes 1 and 3) or M2's (themes 2, 4 and 5), so none covered themes 6, 7 or 8. FOLLOW-UPS §18 accounts for all 29 commits: 26 are covered by an item here, 2 are skills docs with no surface (#32088, #32189), and #30862 is a false match ("snapshot preflight" is the release workflow).

## Theme 6: action preflight and page bindings (5 items: 4 active, 1 planned)

- `studio-authoring.action-preflight-authoring-refusals` (P1, api): the save door's 422 for each `preflight` contradiction at its located path: no params, beside `execution: 'aggregate'`, a hole outside the closed set (with its own sentence for `${result.*}`), an undeclared param, an unclosed hole, a URL off this origin or opening with a hole, a non-GET method, `write` and `title`, and the four seed contradictions.
- `records-forms.action-preflight-panel` (P1, browser): the panel's loading → ready states with the declared fields, the seeded param drawn read-only and submitted, and a failed read that leaves the seed empty and holds Confirm. `waiting`, the stale-answer drop and the seed cleared on a URL change are scored from the pins: the record read accepts only `select` and `expand`, so no stock read carries a `${param.X}` hole (§18b).
- `studio-authoring.page-row-table-block` (P2, browser): a scratch page over `/api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry`: columns in order, enum labels, datetimes in the display zone, "—", the empty label, and the error panel for a non-list and an undrawn format.
- `studio-authoring.page-api-binding-reread-after-action` (P2, browser): one more GET after the page's own successful action with the old rows kept in flight, and none after a failed one.
- Planned: `ai.pending-action-held-approval`. The spec and the AI approvals inbox declare a `held` status; no open-tree producer sets it (the AI service is Cloud/EE). §18a.

## Theme 7: AI data tools and MCP (6 items: 5 runnable, 1 blocked)

- `ai.mcp-dataset-tools` (P1, api): `list_datasets` (members, term matches by name, label and synonym) and `query_dataset` (rows, provenance, `rowCount`, `truncated`, no `sql`; NOT_FOUND for a missing dataset; the alias and selection-member prescriptions).
- `studio-authoring.dataset-member-vocabulary` (P2, mixed): the save door's synonym refusals (repeated, owned by another member, untrimmed, over 60 characters, a description over 500), Studio's Synonyms and Description rows, and a synonym match through `list_datasets`.
- `ai.mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction` (P1, api): PDF and Word text with the facts block, the one-file input refusals, the CPU-time budget note, and a malformed `OS_MCP_READ_FILE_CPU_BUDGET_MS` failing the boot. The concurrency cap's 503 and the 10 MiB cap are scored from the pins.
- `ai.mcp-tool-call-interceptor` (P2, api): allow, deny with the coded envelope (the tool never runs), a malformed verdict refused as a server fault, an unregistered name observed with `registered: false`, and the stdio door. Its fixture is an inline plugin in a scratch copy of the showcase, read from the plugin contract and not booted (§18b, §18c).
- `records-forms.list-link-filter-refused-whole` (P2, browser): one dropped condition refuses the whole `uf__filter`, the address bar loses it, and one notice says so.
- Blocked (`environment`): `ai.chat-answer-list-link`. The chat needs an AI service with an agent and a model; service-ai is Cloud/EE. The link parse and target are pinned.
- Revision: `ai.mcp-http-surface` rev 10. `acceptance[4]` counted 15 HTTP tools and 10 on stdio (measured before #31773); with `list_datasets` and `query_dataset` on both doors the counts are 17 and 12. Read from source, not counted live.

## Theme 8: federation and the CLI (8 items: 5 runnable, 3 blocked)

- `integration-system.federation-only-driver-catalog` (P2, mixed): `federationOnly: true` on oracle and mssql only, and the New datasource dialog offering External and Validate with the sentence that says why Managed is not offered.
- `integration-system.federation-only-managed-refusal` (P1, mixed): a managed oracle or mssql datasource refused 400 at `schemaMode` at the admin door and by `os validate`; the oracle config's inline password and URL refusals. Every call is refused before any connection, so it needs no Oracle.
- `cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json` (P1, cli): `os deploy --dry-run` (the plan, nothing installed, whether it would stop), `--json` (one document on stdout, human lines on stderr), the install, and an upgrade refused off a TTY with the `--confirm-upgrade` command.
- `cli.validate-target-restriction-profile` (P2, cli): the `[rule] where: message` rows with exit 1, the file and URL refusals (never judged as no restriction), and the version drift as a warning.
- `cli.package-upgrade-plan-override-advice` (P2, mixed): the upgrade dry run that writes nothing, the advisory section naming a `.custom` override that hides a change, install-local's `dryRun` refusal, and the install proceeding without a token.
- Blocked (`fixture`), each stating its fixture: `integration-system.oracle-federated-read-write`, `integration-system.oracle-raw16-uuid-reference`, `integration-system.mssql-federated-read-write`. Why: they need a credentialed Oracle Database or SQL Server. `node scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs external-database` (#32233, merged as #32277) provisions PostgreSQL only and refuses a URL that is not `postgres://`; no CI job runs either engine. §18c proposes an `oracle` and an `mssql` arm.

## What changes

- 19 new items across `ai`, `studio-authoring`, `records-forms`, `integration-system` and `cli`, each with `source[]` anchors that resolve and a history row citing #32269. One revision (`ai.mcp-http-surface` rev 10).
- `coverage.json`: the preflight items are mapped to `action`, the row-table and re-read items to `page`, the dataset items to `dataset`, the federation-only items to `datasource`, the list-link item to `view`, the deploy and upgrade-plan items to `manifest`, and the restriction-profile item to `hook`. The read_file and interceptor items exercise MCP, which is no governed metadata kind. The planned item and the four blocked items are mapped nowhere.
- `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §18: scope and angles, the item list, the commit accounting, 18a (planned), 18b (notes for owners), 18c (fixtures worth adding), 18d (security note).

## Why

The 18.4.0 release run selects `since:v18.4`. Before this PR it held nothing for the action preflight, page bindings, the dataset AI tools, read_file extraction, the MCP interceptor, Oracle and SQL Server federation, `os deploy` to a runtime or `os validate --target`, all landed after 18.3.0 (epic #32022, M3).

## Verification

On head `368f2a13` (base `9091955b`; `origin/main` has since moved six commits, none touching `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` or any file an item cites):

- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` → exit 0 (16 areas, 421 items: 412 active, 4 planned; coverage 40 kinds mapped, 4 waived; 10/10 recipes referenced; symbol anchors 1504/1514 resolved, the other 10 on the named #16898 residual).
- `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json` → exit 0, 48 runnable items (34 before), 14 of them from this PR: theme 6 × 4, theme 7 × 5, theme 8 × 5. With `--include-blocked`: 58 (4 more from this PR: theme 7 × 1, theme 8 × 3). The planned item is not selected.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` → 16 commands, each run with its exit recorded: 16 × exit 0. `--ran` on that record: `16 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED` (exit 0). The first pass in this fresh worktree had 7 gates exit 3 (no `node_modules`, then `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt); after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts` and `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`, all 16 exited 0, and those are the exits recorded.
- Diff: 7 files, +1660 / -11 (1,671 changed lines, under 3,000).

## Acceptance notes

- **Read from source, not from titles.** Each assertion was read in the code it cites. Drafts were corrected against the code: the MCP dataset row cap is the server's `maxQueryLimit` (50 by default), not a tool constant alone; the restriction-profile header reads "(N items)", not "item(s)"; the preflight's `waiting` state has no stock live leg (above).
- **Blocked, not faked.** The four blocked items state the fixture they need. The federation-only refusals stay runnable because they are refused before any connection.
- **No live checklist run was made**; that is the QA seat's `since:v18.4` run on the release candidate.
- No changeset: `docs/qa/` only, labelled `skip-changeset`.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/**` is untouched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No lintable source changed: JSON and Markdown under `docs/qa/` only.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes; labelled `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (All but the `## 维护者速读` block, which the order asks for in Chinese.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
